book: The PO was waiting for our Plant Director's signature, and he was travelling last week.

family.ex: Please sign the delivery note on receipt.
family.ar: لو سمحت امضي إذن التسليم وانت بتستلم.
family.ex2: Our driver will wait until you sign it.
family.ar2: السواق بتاعنا هيستنى لحد ما تمضيه.

family.ex: The PO is waiting for the director's signature.
family.ex2: Without his signature, procurement cannot send it.
family.ar2: من غير إمضته، المشتريات مش هتقدر تبعته.

family.ex: Please find attached the signed handover report.
family.ex2: The signed copy is needed for the invoice.

family.ex: Only authorised signatories can sign cheques above EGP 500,000.
family.ar: المفوّضين بالإمضا بس يقدروا يمضوا شيكات فوق 500 ألف جنيه.
family.ex2: Our Finance Director is the main signatory.
family.ar2: المدير المالي هو المفوّض الأساسي بالإمضا.

syn.note: informal; final approval, not always a written name
syn.ex: We need the CFO's sign-off on this discount.
syn.ar: محتاجين موافقة المدير المالي على الخصم ده.

syn.note: short signature on each page of a document
syn.ex: Please add your initials on every page of the contract.
syn.ar: لو سمحت حط الأحرف الأولى من اسمك على كل صفحة في العقد.
syn.ex2: Then sign in full on the last page.
syn.ar2: وبعدين امضي إمضة كاملة في آخر صفحة.

syn.note: company seal, often needed next to the signature
syn.ex: The PO needs a signature and the company stamp.
syn.ex2: Without the stamp, our bank won't accept it.
syn.ar2: من غير الختم البنك مش هيقبله.

steps.ex: He put his initials on the revised price.
steps.ar: حط الأحرف الأولى من اسمه جنب السعر المعدّل.
steps.ex2: Initials show he saw the change.
steps.ar2: الأحرف الأولى بتبيّن إنه شاف التعديل.

steps.ex: The PO needs the Plant Director's signature.
steps.ex2: His signature makes the order official.

steps.ex: Cheques need a signature and stamp to be valid.
steps.ar: الشيكات محتاجة إمضا وختم عشان تبقى سليمة.
steps.ex2: The bank checks both the signature and stamp carefully.

ctx: The PO is ready but still waiting for the director's signature. He is back from Aswan tomorrow, so we expect it by noon.
ctx_ar: الـ‎PO‎ جاهز بس لسه مستني إمضة المدير. هو راجع من أسوان بكرة، فمتوقعينه قبل الضهر.

quiz.s: The PO is waiting for the director's ___.
Please find attached the ___ delivery note.
Please put your ___ on every page of the contract.
quiz.ar: لو سمحت حط الأحرف الأولى من اسمك على كل صفحة في العقد.

book: Any delay after that may move the installation to December.

family.ex: Sorry for the delay in sending the PO.
family.ar: آسف على التأخير في بعت الـ‎PO.‎
family.ex2: The delay was due to the director's travel.

family.ex: Customs may delay the battery shipment by a week.
family.ar: الجمارك ممكن تأخّر شحنة البطاريات أسبوع.
family.ex2: We will tell the client if they delay it.

family.ex: The delayed shipment will reach Alexandria port on Sunday.
family.ar: الشحنة المتأخرة هتوصل ميناء إسكندرية يوم الحد.
family.ex2: We will deliver the delayed batteries on Tuesday.

syn.ex: There's a small hold-up at customs.
syn.ex2: The hold-up should clear by tomorrow.

syn.note: a problem that slows the whole project
syn.ex: The wrong PO was a setback for our schedule.
syn.ex2: We recovered from the setback in two days.

syn.note: formal; moved to a later date on purpose
syn.ex: The client asked for a postponement of the site visit.
syn.ex2: The postponement is until after the holiday.

ant.ex: Can we bring forward the delivery to 15 November?
ant.ex2: The client wants to bring the lab opening forward.

steps.ex: There is a slight delay; the truck will arrive at 2 pm.
steps.ar: فيه تأخير بسيط؛ العربية هتوصل الساعة 2.
steps.ex2: The installation plan stays the same.

steps.ex: The battery delay moves installation by one week.
steps.ex2: We updated the schedule and informed the client.

steps.ex: A serious delay at the port could push us into January.
steps.ar: تأخير كبير في الميناء ممكن يزقّنا لحد يناير.
steps.ex2: That would miss the lab opening completely.

ctx: The battery supplier needs our order by 6 November. Any delay after that may move the installation to December.
ctx_ar: مورد البطاريات محتاج الأوردر بتاعنا قبل 6 نوفمبر. أي تأخير بعد كده ممكن يأجّل التركيب لديسمبر.

quiz.s: Sorry for the ___ in sending the PO.
quiz.ar: آسف على التأخير في بعت الـ‎PO.‎

quiz.s: The ___ shipment will reach the port on Sunday.
quiz.ar: الشحنة المتأخرة هتوصل الميناء يوم الحد.

quiz.s: The client wants to ___ the installation to 15 November.
quiz.ar: العميل عايز يقدّم التركيب لـ15 نوفمبر.

book: On 26 October, you mentioned that the PO would be issued last week, but we have not received it yet.

family.ex: Procurement will issue the PO tomorrow.
family.ex2: Once they issue it, we order the batteries.

family.ex: We have an issue with the UPS cooling fan.
family.ar: عندنا مشكلة في مروحة تبريد الـ‎UPS.‎
family.ex2: Our engineer will fix the issue on Sunday.

family.ex: E-invoice issuance was delayed because the portal was down.
family.ar: إصدار الفواتير الإلكترونية اتأخر عشان البوابة كانت واقعة.

family.ex: The cheque issuer must sign next to any correction.
family.ar: اللي مطلّع الشيك لازم يمضي جنب أي تصحيح.
family.ex2: Otherwise, the bank will return it to the issuer.

meanings.ex: We issued e-invoice INV-0457 on the ETA system.
meanings.ar: طلّعنا الفاتورة الإلكترونية ‎INV-0457‎ على سيستم الـ‎ETA.‎
meanings.ex2: The invoice was issued after commissioning.

meanings.ex: Is there an issue with the PO?
meanings.ex2: Yes, the battery quantity is wrong.

meanings.ex: The store issued two batteries to the technician.
meanings.ex2: Every item issued must be recorded.

syn.note: for POs and requests: raise a PO
syn.ex: We will raise the PO this week.
The PO will be released after the director signs.
syn.ar: الـ‎PO‎ هيتبعت بعد ما المدير يمضي.

ant.ex: We cancelled the old PO after they issued Rev.1.
ant.ar: لغينا الـ‎PO‎ القديم بعد ما طلّعوا ‎Rev.1.‎
ant.ex2: Please do not invoice the cancelled PO.
ant.ar2: لو سمحت متعملش فاتورة على الـ‎PO‎ الملغي.

ctx: Procurement promised to issue the PO last week, but we have not received it. Is there any issue with the quotation?
ctx_ar: المشتريات وعدت تطلّع الـ‎PO‎ الأسبوع اللي فات، بس ما استلمناهوش. فيه أي مشكلة في عرض السعر؟

quiz.s: The PO will be ___ once the director signs it.
quiz.ar: الـ‎PO‎ هيطلع أول ما المدير يمضيه.

quiz.s: E-invoice ___ stopped while the portal was down.
quiz.ar: إصدار الفواتير الإلكترونية وقف وقت ما البوابة كانت واقعة.

quiz.s: Please ___ a PO so we can order the batteries.
quiz.ar: لو سمحت اعمل ‎PO‎ عشان نقدر نطلب البطاريات.

family.ex2: We will start the order once we receive the corrected PO.
family.ar2: هنبدأ الأوردر أول ما نستلم الـ‎PO‎ المصحّح.

family.ex: We confirm receipt of your PO.
family.ex2: Delivery is three weeks from receipt.
family.ar2: التسليم بعد تلات أسابيع من الاستلام.

family.ex: Please check the recipient's email before sending the invoice.
family.ar: لو سمحت اتأكد من إيميل المستلم قبل ما تبعت الفاتورة.
family.ex2: The recipient should be Accounts Payable.

family.ex: Our receivables grew this quarter because of late payments.
family.ar: المستحقات بتاعتنا زادت الربع ده بسبب التأخير في الدفع.
family.ex2: Accounts Receivable is following up on every receivable.
family.ar2: الحسابات المدينة بتتابع كل مبلغ مستحق.

meanings.ex: Please confirm receipt of the cheques.
meanings.ex2: Our courier needs it for his records.

meanings.ex: We will send an official receipt once the cheque clears.
meanings.ar: هنبعت إيصال رسمي أول ما الشيك يتصرف.
meanings.ex2: The receipt shows the amount and date.

syn.note: formal reply confirming you got a document
syn.ex: We sent an order acknowledgement the same day.
syn.ar: بعتنا تأكيد استلام الأوردر في نفس اليوم.
syn.ex2: The acknowledgement listed every line item.

syn.note: any document showing a payment was made
syn.ex: Please send proof of payment for the transfer.
syn.ar: لو سمحت ابعت إثبات الدفع للتحويل.
syn.ex2: A bank screenshot is fine as proof of payment.
syn.ar2: سكرين شوت من البنك تكفي كإثبات دفع.

ant.ex: In case of non-receipt within five days, please inform us.
ant.ar: لو مستلمتش خلال خمس أيام، بلّغنا لو سمحت.
ant.ex2: Non-receipt may mean the courier had the wrong address.
ant.ar2: عدم الاستلام ممكن يكون معناه إن المندوب معاه عنوان غلط.

ctx: Thank you for sending PO-2025-118. We confirm receipt and will reply on the delivery date today.
ctx_ar: شكراً على بعت ‎PO-2025-118.‎ بنأكّد الاستلام وهنرد بخصوص ميعاد التسليم النهارده.

quiz.s: Please put the correct ___ email on the invoice.
quiz.ar: لو سمحت حط إيميل المستلم الصح على الفاتورة.

book: Could you please send us a corrected PO?

family.ex: Please correct the battery quantity on the PO.
family.ar: لو سمحت صحّح عدد البطاريات على الـ‎PO.‎
family.ex2: It should be 40 units, as quoted.
Please use it on all invoices.
family.ar2: لو سمحت استخدمه في كل الفواتير.

family.ex: Thank you for the quick correction.
family.ex2: The correction was done in one day.
The bank will accept them now that they're signed correctly.

meanings.ex: Is the total on the PO correct?
We corrected the tax number and reissued the invoice.
meanings.ar: صحّحنا الرقم الضريبي وطلّعنا الفاتورة تاني.

syn.ex: Can you fix the date on the delivery note?
syn.ar: ممكن تظبط التاريخ على إذن التسليم؟
syn.ex2: I'll fix it and send it back.

syn.ex: Please amend the PO to show 40 batteries.
syn.ar: لو سمحت عدّل الـ‎PO‎ عشان يبقى 40 بطارية.
syn.ex2: The amended PO needs a new signature.

syn.note: very formal; for errors and faults
syn.ex: The supplier must rectify the fault at no cost.
syn.ar: المورد لازم يصلّح العطل من غير تكلفة.
syn.ex2: The contract says they rectify faults within 48 hours.
syn.ar2: العقد بيقول إنهم بيصلّحوا الأعطال خلال 48 ساعة.

ant.ex: The PO shows an incorrect total.
ant.ex2: The incorrect figure came from the first quotation.
ant.ar2: الرقم الغلط جه من أول عرض سعر.

ant.ex: The payee name on the cheques is wrong.
ant.ex2: With the wrong name, the bank may refuse them.

ctx: The PO shows 32 batteries instead of 40. Could you please send us a corrected PO with the agreed total?
ctx_ar: الـ‎PO‎ مكتوب فيه 32 بطارية بدل 40. ممكن تبعتلنا ‎PO‎ مصحّح بالإجمالي المتفق عليه؟

quiz.s: Thank you for the quick ___ of the PO.
Under the contract, the supplier must ___ any fault at no cost.
quiz.ar: حسب العقد، المورد لازم يصلّح أي عطل من غير تكلفة.
